After releasing two EPs, their debut album, How Do You Feel Now?, was released through their own Cultco Music label, an imprint of Hollywood Records, in 2015.

It was followed by their third album, Possession, which was released on March 13, 2020.

The discography of American indie rock band Joywave consists of five studio albums, one remix/compilation album, three extended plays, two mixtapes, and 18 singles.

In the same year, they signed to major label Hollywood Records and founded their own label, Cultco Music, as an imprint of Hollywood.
